title: A/P Detail: a bill belongs to the location of its delivery
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a vendor with two unpaid bills: bill A, received on a delivery at location A, and bill B, received on a delivery at location B.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Vendor filter showing that vendor ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location of bill A and bill B.
  2. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  3. Expand every bucket and look for bill A and bill B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill A shows location A.
  • Bill B shows location B: each bill shows the location of the delivery it was received on.

Step 2:

  • The report narrows to location A.

Step 3:

  • Bill A is listed.
  • Bill B is not.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications, Q2 A/P row location: “A vendor account is per (vendor, location) on every write path (delivery, manual credit, return credit), so vendor_account.workplace_id already is the document's location.”
